context: New current observations span XRP derivatives, ETF holdings, Circle USDC supply, Coinbase XRP-backed loans, U.S. macro fund flows and Binance's aggregate incident response. The sources have different coverage and cannot be flattened into one directional signal.
decisions: Store derivatives observations by provider, venue/contract universe, observation timestamp and metric definition; never average incompatible open-interest aggregates.

Build ETF flow history from issuer-native holdings and fund-specific settled timestamps. Preserve provisional and flow-excluded funds as explicit missing/partial states rather than treating them as zero economic flow.
Store ETF holdings changes separately from net external capital, spot purchases and price; issuer holdings are not proof of unhedged new demand.
Store Circle's global USDC circulation separately from Base and XRPL chain supplies, Circle Mint fiat flows and Morpho vault suppliers.

Represent Coinbase's XRP-backed USDC loan product as a collateral-utility rail: XRP underlying, cbXRP representation, Morpho collateral, USDC debt, Coinbase interface and borrower proceeds are distinct series.
Respect Coinbase's official restriction against using loan proceeds to trade on Coinbase; do not infer spot XRP purchases from loan issuance.
Treat U.S. macro fund flows and Binance aggregate reserve statements as contextual event variables, not XRP-specific capital or collateral measurements.

Keep all new observations out of the price-prediction feature set until synchronized point-in-time history, independent corroboration, leakage controls, walk-forward baseline comparisons and calibration are complete.
invariants: A provider's account-count long/short ratio is not notional exposure.
A market-wide Morpho balance is not Coinbase customer volume or Circle-provided lending capital.
cbXRP collateral seized by a Morpho liquidator is not automatically native XRP sold on an exchange.
ETF holdings change is not automatically net new external capital or unhedged spot buying.
Global USDC circulation does not establish Base/XRPL chain balances or a Circle lender position.
Macro flows from U.S. mutual funds do not establish crypto or XRP fund flows.
Aggregate Binance incident reserves do not establish XRP-specific reserve restoration.
